newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines 8-month car sales up 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines 8-month car sales up 25 pct.

text.p: The Philippines' car sales rose 25 percent to 58,382 units in the first eight months compared with 46,675 in the year-ago period, Honda Car Philippines Inc reported on Wednesday.
It cited the final data from the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines.

Over the weekend, a preliminary report, also from Honda, said car sales of the Philippines' four largest assemblers jumped 23.5 percent to 44,140 units in the first eight months of the year compared with the year-ago 35,746 units.
The report covered sales of 15 car assemblers selling cars with engine displacements of 1.2 liters to over 2.0 liters.
As usual, the Japanese car assemblers led the pack. Honda Cars Philippines Inc had the biggest market share of 23 percent, equivalent to 13,704 units.

This was followed by Toyota Motor Philippines Corp with 12,968 units, or 22 percent of the market, Mitsubishi Motors with 9,460 units or 16 percent, and Nissan Motor Philippines Inc with 8,008 units or 13.7 percent.
